run_training_job: run the main training job by invoking train.py with command line arguments
build_game_from_opts: build a game object from parsed options using build_game(opts)
build_optimizer_and_scheduler: build an optimizer and learning rate scheduler from the game and learning rate
get_dataloader: get the training data loader for the template game using get_dataloader()
train_with_trainer: train the game using core.Trainer with a specified number of epochs
